description: This PHP source file contains a PHPUnit test class 'LDAPSyncServiceCreateSystemUsersTest' that verifies the functionality of the LDAP synchronization service within the OrangeHRM system, focusing on creating and updating system users based on LDAP data.

classes.name: LDAPSyncServiceCreateSystemUsersTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing LDAP synchronization and user creation functionalities in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, setting fixture directory and mocking DateTimeHelperService, then sets up kernel with required services.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsers
methods.description: Verifies that creating system users via LDAPSyncService adds the expected number of users, user auth providers, and employees.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWithLocalUsers
methods.description: Tests the creation of system users when some local users are already prepopulated, ensuring new LDAP users are added correctly.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWithEmployeeMapping
methods.description: Checks LDAP user creation and employee last name update via mapping, especially when LDAP data overwrites existing employee data.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWhenUsernameChanged
methods.description: Ensures users are correctly updated or replaced when LDAP username changes are detected.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWhenFieldsNotChanged
methods.description: Confirms that no changes occur when LDAP data fields remain unchanged, testing idempotency of user creation.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWhenFieldsChanged
methods.description: Verifies that user data is updated properly in the system when LDAP attributes have been modified.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWithNonUniqueEmployeeIdAndWorkEmail
methods.description: Tests handling of duplicate employee IDs and emails in LDAP data, ensuring proper student associations.

methods.name: getLDAPUsers
methods.description: Constructs and returns a list of LDAPUser objects with sample data for testing LDAP synchronization.
